description: macOS-compatible (Darwin) shape provisioning. Darwin is NOT a Debian/apt system, so the 'minimal base + first-boot apt-get' model does not apply. The bootable Darwin OS is produced by macos/build-shape.sh darwin-os (compiled, baked via PureDarwin). Darwin software is provisioned with its own pkg-style tooling (and, where used, a Homebrew-equivalent) post-install, not apt. This descriptor records that choice so the OS Creator does not attempt an apt provision on the macOS shape.

firstBoot: echo 'Darwin OS provisions software via pkg-style tooling post-install; no apt. See macos/BUILD.md.'
